speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Mine is in the reed with hers. I am getting her out before the river decides she lives there.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: She was resting. A hand is a hand. It is not a rescue, and it is not a loss.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I have the book. I am not opening it again on a bank. If the pie is still a pie, it is at home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hands in, hulls out. We are going while the middle is still the middle I named.
